name: ref-inject
description: Attaches a reference auto-injection mechanism to a plugin (new or existing). /ref-inject:apply copies a PreToolUse hook that injects edit-path-matched references (required full-body, optional pointer) using a TTL-based per-session YAML token. Also installs a PreToolUse references-edit-guard hook reminding to update _index.yaml / _injection_rules.yaml before editing or creating files under references/. Injection part only — plugin.json/CLAUDE.md/marketplace are plugin-creator's job.
